args.subject: Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! I'm Emma Johnson from the team, and I just wanted to send you a warm welcome as you join us next week.

We're thrilled to have you on board in the marketing department. If you have any questions about onboarding, tools, or getting settled in, please don't hesitate to reach out — I'm happy to help.

Looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
